sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import copy
def eyes(f):
    s=f.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S':
            b=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
            out.append((r0,c0))
    out.sort(key=lambda x:(x[1],x[0]))
    return out
def done(res):
    return res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('run_complete') or res.get('game_over')
print("start", eyes(current_frame))
# Try SPREAD (LEFT) up to 3 times
seq=[]
for i in range(3):
    r=action(['LEFT'], intent='explore')
    seq.append(('LEFT', eyes(current_frame), done(r)))
    print("after LEFT",i, eyes(current_frame), "done=",done(r))
    if done(r): break
# Try SQUEEZE (RIGHT) up to 5 times to bring together
for i in range(5):
    r=action(['RIGHT'], intent='explore')
    seq.append(('RIGHT', eyes(current_frame), done(r)))
    print("after RIGHT",i, eyes(current_frame), "done=",done(r))
    if done(r): break
print("final step", current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
